title: Second face found in Utopia

tellings.quote: And then I went and looked at a different part of Mars that was also on the seashore of this ocean and found another site with two faces, one of which looks like the same face inside a helmet as at Cydonia.

plain: A physicist named John Brandenburg says that in the 1980s he studied a part of Mars called Utopia, which he says sat on the shore of an ancient Martian ocean, and found a site with two faces in the landscape. He tells Michels that one of them looks like the same face seen at Cydonia, a Martian region known for a rock formation shaped like a face, but inside a helmet. If true, a second matching face would suggest the shapes were made, not natural.
